legend: Pikachu had an array with him. He wrote down all the non-empty subsequences of the array on paper. Note that an array of size n has 2n - 1 non-empty subsequences in it.
Pikachu being mischievous as he always is, removed all the subsequences in which Maximum_element_of_the_subsequence  -  Minimum_element_of_subsequence  ≥ d
Pikachu was finally left with X subsequences.

However, he lost the initial array he had, and now is in serious trouble. He still remembers the numbers X and d. He now wants you to construct any such array which will satisfy the above conditions. All the numbers in the final array should be positive integers less than 1018.
Note the number of elements in the output array should not be more than 104. If no answer is possible, print  - 1.
input: The only line of input consists of two space separated integers X and d (1 ≤ X, d ≤ 109).
output: Output should consist of two lines.
First line should contain a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10 000)— the number of integers in the final array.
Second line should consist of n space separated integers — a1, a2, ... , an (1 ≤ ai < 1018).
If there is no answer, print a single integer -1. If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
note: In the output of the first example case, the remaining subsequences after removing those with Maximum_element_of_the_subsequence  -  Minimum_element_of_subsequence  ≥ 5 are [5], [5, 7], [5, 6], [5, 7, 6], [50], [7], [7, 6], [15], [6], [100]. There are 10 of them. Hence, the array [5, 50, 7, 15, 6, 100] is valid.

Similarly, in the output of the second example case, the remaining sub-sequences after removing those with Maximum_element_of_the_subsequence  -  Minimum_element_of_subsequence  ≥ 2 are [10], [100], [1000], [10000]. There are 4 of them. Hence, the array [10, 100, 1000, 10000] is valid.

legend.ai: Pikachu 手头有一个数组。他将该数组的所有非空子序列写在了纸上。注意，一个大小为 n 的数组有 2n - 1 个非空子序列。
Pikachu 一如既往地调皮，删除了所有满足 Maximum_element_of_the_subsequence  -  Minimum_element_of_subsequence  ≥ d 的子序列。
最后，Pikachu 剩下了 X 个子序列。
然而，他弄丢了原来的数组，现在遇到了严重的麻烦。他还记得数字 X 和 d。现在，他希望你构造出任意一个满足上述条件的数组。最终数组中的所有数字都应为小于 1018 的正整数。
注意，输出数组中的元素个数不应超过 10^4。如果无解，输出 -1。

input.ai: 输入仅有一行，包含两个以空格分隔的整数 X 和 d（1 ≤ X, d ≤ 10^9）。

output.ai: 第一行应包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10 000）——最终数组中的整数个数。
第二行应包含 n 个以空格分隔的整数——a1, a2, ..., an（1 ≤ a_i < 10^18）。
如果无解，输出一个整数 -1。如果有多个答案，输出其中任意一个即可。

note.ai: 在第一个样例的输出中，移除满足 Maximum_element_of_the_subsequence  -  Minimum_element_of_subsequence  ≥ 5 的子序列后，剩余的子序列为 [5]、[5, 7]、[5, 6]、[5, 7, 6]、[50]、[7]、[7, 6]、[15]、[6]、[100]。它们共有 10 个。因此，数组 [5, 50, 7, 15, 6, 100] 是有效的。
类似地，在第二个样例的输出中，移除满足 Maximum_element_of_the_subsequence  -  Minimum_element_of_subsequence  ≥ 2 的子序列后，剩余的子序列为 [10]、[100]、[1000]、[10000]。它们共有 4 个。因此，数组 [10, 100, 1000, 10000] 是有效的。
